title: the_light_on_the_fifth_floor
display_title: Every night for three weeks that light was on. Last Thursday it wasn't.
beats: Every single night for three weeks, the same light was on in that building. Last Thursday it wasn't.
I walk the same route home every night. Same eleven blocks, same twenty-three minute walk, same buildings.
For twenty-one nights straight, the third window on the fifth floor of that corner building had a light on.
Always on when I left work at midnight. Always on when I passed by.
I started noticing it around day four.
By day ten I was looking for it before I even turned the corner. It had become part of the route.
Then last Thursday, night twenty-two, it was off.
I stopped walking. Just stood there on the sidewalk for a second.
I don't know why it bothered me so much. I still don't.
caption: For 21 nights, the light was on. Night 22, it wasn't. I stood there on the sidewalk at midnight not knowing why it mattered. It just did. #nosleep #creepystorytime #truescarystories #storytime #trending
share_line: Save this one. I want to know if it happens to you too.
